scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong industry match is available
focus: Organ-on-chip and complex in vitro/preclinical models
scope.selection_rule: Current actionable roles only; stale or expired postings excluded from this snapshot.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Complex In Vitro Model
jobs.company_info: AbbVie Immunology's Complex In Vitro Model group supports inflammatory and autoimmune drug discovery using human-relevant systems.
jobs.posting_status: Active official employer posting with Apply button
jobs.job_description: Design and interpret drug-potency and mechanism studies using primary human cells, organoids, organ-on-chip and other complex in vitro systems in immunology discovery.
key_must_have_requirements: Primary human immune-cell and tissue culture
ELISA/MSD, PCR, multicolor flow cytometry and high-content microscopy
jobs.why_good_match: The closest direct industry translation of Crohn's organoid/chip work: inflammatory biology, advanced human models and mechanistic assay development are central duties.
likely_gaps: Primary immune-cell and multicolor-flow depth may be weaker than organoid/chip expertise
Posting is framed around BS/MS plus substantial experience, so the resume must translate doctoral ownership into industry-relevant execution
jobs.tailor: Lead with patient-derived intestinal organoids, host-microbiome chips, barrier/ROS/inflammation assays, confocal imaging and quantitative validation; describe platform work in terms of reproducibility and drug-discovery decisions.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply now with an industry resume that mirrors complex-in-vitro, inflammatory-disease, assay-robustness and high-content-imaging language.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Respiratory Biology (Discovery Research)
jobs.company_info: Merck's Respiratory Biology Discovery group uses human-relevant in vitro, ex vivo and translational systems for chronic inflammatory and fibrotic lung disease.

salary.note: Current posted range surfaced across active listings.

jobs.job_description: Develop and apply primary-cell, organoid, co-culture and tissue systems to target validation, mechanism-of-action, fibrosis, regeneration and translational biomarker studies.
key_must_have_requirements: Human primary-cell and disease-relevant advanced in vitro models
Independent mechanistic study design and interpretation
jobs.why_good_match: The organ system changes, but the core work—human epithelial models, inflammatory mechanisms, fibrosis/remodeling, imaging and omics—is highly transferable and would broaden the disease portfolio beyond GI.
likely_gaps: Direct respiratory biology and airway/alveolar culture experience
Less depth in flow cytometry and multiplex biomarker platforms than in chip/imaging work
jobs.tailor: Translate Crohn's/radiation work into epithelial injury, regeneration, inflammatory signaling and fibrosis-relevant model development; foreground confocal imaging, scRNA-seq and patient-derived systems.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply if willing to pivot organ systems; make the cover letter explicitly explain why advanced human-model expertise transfers from intestine to lung.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist — Advanced Human Model Systems
jobs.company: National Center to Accelerate Cures / Blackbird Laboratories
jobs.company_info: NCAC is building infrastructure to validate and standardize New Approach Methodologies for regulatory decision-making.
jobs.job_description: Implement externally developed organoid and organ-on-chip platforms, standardize workflows, benchmark performance, develop SOPs and support NAM validation studies.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD with typically 4+ years relevant experience
Hands-on experience across advanced human model systems
jobs.why_good_match: It converts organ-chip expertise into the rarer NAM validation/regulatory-translation lane and would differentiate a future independent research profile.
likely_gaps: Limited formal GLP/GCLP/GMP and audit-ready validation experience
jobs.tailor: Emphasize platform transfer, PDMS fabrication QC, reproducibility, SOP development, comparative validation and human-relevant model context-of-use rather than only disease biology.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply as a stretch and explicitly position doctoral platform ownership as advanced-model implementation and validation experience.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist — Tissue Engineering / 3D Bioprinting
jobs.company_info: The Philadelphia operation is scaling patient-derived, industrialized 3D tissue models for precision medicine and preclinical services.
jobs.posting_status: Current listing remains surfaced; separate lower-level Senior Laboratory Scientist posting expired September 22 and was excluded
jobs.job_description: Lead implementation and validation of advanced 3D bioprinting, bio-ink and multicellular tissue-model workflows, assay development, technology transfer and genomic fidelity analysis.
key_must_have_requirements: 3D bioprinting/tissue engineering or advanced multicellular models
jobs.why_good_match: Strong bridge from organ-chip engineering into commercial biofabrication, with direct overlap in primary human models, microfluidics, tissue engineering and RNA-seq-based model validation.
likely_gaps: Posting prefers substantial commercial research leadership
jobs.tailor: Use a fabrication-forward resume and visual portfolio showing membrane fabrication, 3D printing, device iteration, organoid/chip models and quantitative QC.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply and ask early how much of the role is true R&D/model invention versus technology-transfer and client-production execution.

jobs.title: Scientist III — Cell Biology & Functional Genomics
jobs.company_info: The Ridgefield discovery team uses laboratory automation, mammalian cell culture, functional genomics and automated iPSC-derived kidney organoid workflows.

salary.note: Approximately $49.62-$53.16/hour on W2; equivalent annualized range shown.

jobs.job_description: Operate and troubleshoot automated cell-culture and assay workflows, including iPSC-derived kidney organoids, functional genomics and NGS sample processing.
key_must_have_requirements: Mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays
Careful sample tracking and SOP adherence
jobs.why_good_match: A credible way to add iPSC organoids, automation and production-style genomics to an existing organoid/chip and scRNA-seq background.
likely_gaps: Role appears execution-heavy and contract-based rather than platform-owning
Current listing states U.S. citizen or Green Card only
jobs.tailor: Emphasize organoid culture, reproducible workflows, Seurat/scRNA experience, troubleshooting and engineering automation; do not oversell direct iPSC depth.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply only if work authorization fits and the automation/iPSC skill gain justifies a two-year contract.
